data.name: Faika
data.gender_notes: Faika is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is victorious and triumphant, a name of Allah meaning The Victorious One. The name Faika carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Faika usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents victory and triumph in the spiritual sense, often given to a child born after a difficult pregnancy or birth.
data.etymology: Faika belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: فائكة
in_arabic.long_meaning: فائكة من الفَوْقَة، وتعني 'المُفَوَّقة' أو 'المنجحة' أو 'السعيدة'. تُفسر اسم فائكة بما يشير إلى النجاح، والتوفيق، والسّعادة في الحياة. لا يُذكَر اسم فائكة في القرآن الكريم، ولكنه اسم له دلالة إيجابية وروحانية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: فائکہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: فائکہ، یہ نام برِی فَوْقَہ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی 'مُفَوّق'، 'کام یاب' یا 'خوش قسمت' ہیں۔ فائکہ کا نام زندگی میں کامیابی، توفیق اور خوش قسمتی کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔ قرآن میں اس نام کا ذکر نہیں ہے، لیکن یہ یوں سمجھا جاتا ہے کہ یہ ایک خوش آئند اور روحانی نام ہے جو اسلامی تہذیب میں اچھے حوالے سے منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फायका
in_hindi.long_meaning: फायका नाम 'फौका' से उद्भवित है, जिसका अर्थ है 'सफल', 'विजयी' या 'सुखी'. फायका नाम जीवन में सफलता, विजय और खुशी से जुड़ा है। इस नाम का कुरान में कोई उल्लेख नहीं है, लेकिन यह एक शुभ और आध्यात्मिक नाम माना जाता है जो भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में उपयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فائके
in_pashto.long_meaning: فائके نوم له در لُغتي پښتو به معنی “مُوْفِق”، “کامیاب”، “خوشگير” لېږد. نوم فائके د خوشي، کامیابی، او توفیق په اړه د پښتنو تہذیبی ډیر کلیدوال ګڼل کېږي. په قرآن کې نوم فائके ته په نوم یې شوه نه شته، خو د اسلامي روایتونه له مخې د نوم ته د ښه ګڼل کېږي.

in_english.name: Faika
in_english.long_meaning: Faika, an Arabic name with roots in the word 'fawkah' meaning 'success', 'prosperity', or 'fortune'. It carries a positive connotation of achievement, happiness, and good luck. While not mentioned directly in the Quran, Faika is a widely used name in Muslim cultures, symbolizing blessings and a prosperous life.

historical_references.reference: Al-Biruni mentioned Faika as a sister of Caliph Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz in his book 'Al-Athar Al-Biqya' (The Scattered Pages).
historical_references.context: Faika was a member of the Umayyad Dynasty, daughter of Caliph Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, and played an important role in the political and social life of the Umayyad Empire during her brother's reign.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir, in his book 'Al-Bidayah wa'l-Nihayah', mentioned Faika as a wife of Salah al-Din Yusuf ibn Ayyub (Saladin).
historical_references.context: Faika was a Byzantine princess or a Greek noblewoman, and she became one of Saladin's wives. Her marriage to Saladin helped to strengthen the ties between the Islamic and Christian worlds during the Crusades.
